claims.claim: MiMo-V2.6-Pro scores 46 on Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index v4.3.2, the top open-weights model on that index.
Artificial Analysis spent $206.66 in total to evaluate MiMo-V2.6-Pro on the Intelligence Index, which it reports as $0.13 per Index task.
Grok 4.7 (xhigh) also scores 46 on Index v4.3.2, at $3.74 per Index task and $4,967.35 for the full run.
Index v4.3.2 is a weighted average of ten evaluations across four categories: Agents 30%, Coding 20%, General 30%, Scientific Reasoning 20%.
Artificial Analysis estimates a 95% confidence interval for the Intelligence Index of less than plus or minus 1%, derived from more than ten repeats on certain models.
Five of the ten Index constituents, carrying 55% of total weight, are run exactly once per model; only GDP.pdf and CritPt are run five times.
Grok 4.6 was reported at 61 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index on 12 August 2026 and is reported at 44 today, with no change to the model.
Artificial Analysis reported Grok 4.6 at $0.84 per Index task in August 2026 and $1.86 per Index task in September 2026 on an unchanged $2/$6 per million token rate card.
On AA-Omniscience, the Index's factuality constituent, MiMo-V2.6-Pro scores 8 and Grok 4.7 scores 32 despite an identical composite of 46.
On AA-LCR v1.1 MiMo scores 86% against Grok 4.7's 77%; on Terminal-Bench 4.0, 35% against 26%; on HLE, 49% against 43%; on CritPt, 27% against 18%.
On AA-Briefcase v1.1 Grok 4.7 scores 1657 Elo against MiMo's 1522, on GDPval-AA 1695 against 1673, and on AutomationBench-AA 66% against 59%.
Artificial Analysis lists exactly one API provider for MiMo-V2.6-Pro, Xiaomi's own first-party endpoint.

Xiaomi prices MiMo-V2.6-Pro at $0.435 per million input tokens and $0.87 per million output tokens, and the same checkpoint sold as MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed at $4.35 and $8.70, exactly ten times higher.
Xiaomi's stated $2.62M for MiMo-V2.6-Pro covers the Live RL stage only: 30 steps and roughly 750,000 trajectories in under six days, with no pretraining cost disclosed.
Xiaomi acknowledges that behind the six-day run lie half a year of foundational research accumulation and engineering trial and error, which the dollar figure does not cost.
DeepSeek-V3's $5.576M figure covers 2.788M H800 GPU-hours at an assumed $2 per GPU-hour and explicitly excludes prior research and ablation experiments.
Xiaomi's FY2025 group R&D expense was RMB 33.13 billion on revenue of RMB 457.29 billion, with cumulative 2026-2030 R&D guided above RMB 200 billion.
On Xiaomi's own model card MiMo-V2.6-Pro beats Claude Opus 5 on Terminal-Bench 2.1 (89.9 vs 89.1) but loses to it by 14.1 points on Terminal-Bench 4.0 (34.9 vs 49.0).
Terminal-Bench 4.0 is a 66-task set released 26 August 2026 that deliberately removed tasks that were saturated, refusal-prone or publicly solved.
Xiaomi announced 7,000-plus high-quality RL task environments alongside the release, but the task corpus itself was not published; only the harness and recipes are open.
The MiMo-V2.6-Pro model card discloses a Multi-Prefix Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation stage without naming the teacher models.
Two days after release, MiMo-V2.6-Pro's only non-Artificial-Analysis third-party score is an Arena AutoEval proxy of 1628 on Code Arena, explicitly unranked with zero human votes.
Vals.ai has no MiMo-V2.6-Pro evaluation; its model URL returns HTTP 404 while it evaluated Grok 4.7 on release day.
MiMo-V2.5-Pro's 26 and MiMo-V2.6-Pro's 46 are both current v4.3.2 measurements, so the 20-point generational gap is not a naive cross-version artifact.
Artificial Analysis shipped Index v4.2 on 4 September 2026, v4.3 on 7 September and v4.3.2 on 19 September, two days before both MiMo-V2.6-Pro and Grok 4.7 launched.
Evaluations with private questions or answers account for 45% of Index v4.3 weighting, up from 40% in v4.2 and roughly 20% in v4.1.
Epoch AI audited a random sample of 48 Humanity's Last Exam questions and found 22 (46%) had substantial accuracy-altering errors, designating the benchmark Flawed.
Miller (2024) shows a new evaluation needs roughly 969 questions to detect a three-point difference at 80% power, and that clustered standard errors can be over three times larger than naive ones.
A confirmatory factor analysis of 591 LLMs across 12 tests finds a dominant general factor with average loading 0.81 explaining 65.6% of benchmark variance and mean inter-test correlation 0.73.

DeepSeek disclosed a 545% cost-profit margin for V3/R1 inference over one 24-hour window: $87,072 of daily H800 cost against $562,027 of theoretical revenue, while stating actual revenue was substantially lower.

Z.AI's HKEX interim filing reports its gross profit margin rising from -0.4% for the six months to 30 June 2025 to 24.6% for the six months to 30 June 2026, with average API selling price up about 101%.

MiMo-V2.6-Pro is a 1.02-trillion-parameter sparse mixture of experts with 42 billion active parameters, 384 routed experts of which 8 activate, 70 layers of which 60 use 128-token sliding-window attention, and a 1M-token context.
Menlo Ventures estimates Chinese open-source models account for about 1% of enterprise LLM API usage, with open source overall at 11%.
NVIDIA's FY2026 Form 10-K states the company was effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing market as of the end of fiscal year 2026.
Epoch AI estimates Huawei will produce less than 4% as much AI compute as NVIDIA in 2026, with HBM the binding constraint.
The Index v4.3.2 task inventory totals roughly 9,750 single-pass tasks, so $206.66 divided by tasks actually executed is about $0.021, not the $0.13 weighted unit Artificial Analysis publishes.
MiMo-V2.6-Pro generated 140M output tokens on the Index run and Grok 4.7 (xhigh) generated 240M, with Grok using approximately 81k output tokens per Index task against Grok 4.6's 36k.
Artificial Analysis independently evaluated Reflection-70B in September 2024 and could not reproduce its claimed benchmark results even with private API access.
Meta's Llama 4 Maverick advertised an LMArena Elo of 1417 from an experimental chat version; the unmodified public weights ranked 32nd when LMArena scored them on 11 April 2025.
The GSM1k study found contamination gaps are family-specific: Yi-6B-Chat fell 8.0 points and phi-2 6.3 points, while gpt-4o moved -0.2 and claude-3-opus +2.2.
